description: Defines the HpackFuzzUtil class and related structures for fuzz testing HPACK header compression in SPDY/HTTP2, including header generation, input management, and fuzzing stages.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil
classes.description: Utility class for fuzz testing HPACK header compression, including header generation, input handling, and fuzzing stages.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::GeneratorContext
classes.description: Holds ordered header names and values for fuzzing.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::Input
classes.description: Manages an input string and offset for parsing header blocks.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::FuzzerContext
classes.description: Holds the decoder and encoder stages used during fuzz testing.

methods.name: InitializeGeneratorContext
methods.description: Initializes a GeneratorContext with a seed and header fixtures.

methods.name: NextGeneratedHeaderSet
methods.description: Generates a header set from the generator context.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a size from an exponential distribution with a specified mean, bounded by a sanity limit.

methods.name: Input::Input
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the input offset to zero.

methods.name: NextHeaderBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the next header block from input if available.

methods.name: HeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the serialized length prefix for a header block.

methods.name: InitializeFuzzerContext
methods.description: Initializes the FuzzerContext with decoder and encoder stages.

methods.name: RunHeaderBlockThroughFuzzerStages
methods.description: Processes an input block through the fuzzing stages, returning success status.

methods.name: FlipBits
methods.description: Randomly flips bits in a buffer based on the specified rate.
